area: Your projects and how you work

questions.question: Pick the project you are proudest of and walk me through it.
questions.what_they_are_checking: Your ability to explain technical work clearly and own it. Practise a two-minute version and a ten-minute version.

questions.question: What is the hardest bug you have debugged, and how did you find it?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Your debugging process. They want a method - reproduce, isolate, hypothesise - not luck.

questions.question: Why did you choose that technology for your project? What would you use instead now?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether your choices were reasoned or copied from a tutorial, and whether you have reflected since.

questions.question: If you restarted that project tomorrow, what would you do differently?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Self-awareness. 'Nothing' is a bad answer; it suggests you have not reviewed your own work.

questions.question: Your project works for 10 users. What breaks at 10,000?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you can reason about bottlenecks - database queries, memory, blocking work - without hand-waving.

questions.question: Tell me about a time you disagreed with a teammate about a technical decision.
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you can disagree on technical grounds and then commit to the outcome either way.

questions.question: Tell me about something technical you had to learn quickly.
questions.what_they_are_checking: Your learning method - and whether you can be useful before you are expert.

questions.question: You have been stuck on a problem for three hours. What do you do?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you know when to ask for help. Both 'never ask' and 'ask immediately' are wrong answers.

questions.question: Tell me about feedback on your code that was hard to hear.
questions.what_they_are_checking: Whether you separate criticism of code from criticism of yourself.

questions.question: This role lists a skill you have not used. How would you handle that in the first month?
questions.what_they_are_checking: Honesty plus a plan. Pretending you know it is the worst possible answer - prepare this one properly.
